items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I heard him play. At the time he was playing with Walter Brunden then.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Bunker, hear him in the old days?
I heard him play. At the time he was playing with Walter Brunden then. Yeah. He had the, there was two corners. Mangel had the Imperial, he had the Superior Band.
